records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Sales increased slightly in the first quarter of fiscal 2024 as increased sales in our Beef segment were partially offset by decreased sales in our Chicken segment.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Sales Volume – Volumes were essentially flat, accounting for a $2 million decrease in sales as increased sales volume in our Pork and Prepared Foods segments was offset by decreased sales volume in our Beef and Chicken segments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Sales Volume - Sales volume decreased primarily due to reduced domestic production, partially offset by the sell-through of inventory.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our total operating margin was 1.7% in the first quarter of fiscal 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income of $231 million for the first quarter of fiscal 2024 was down 51% as we experienced lower operating income in our Beef segment, partially offset by improved operating income in our Pork and Chicken segments.
